summaries.en: The GitHub project "p-e-w/heretic" is a Python-based tool designed for fully automatic censorship removal in language models. In summary, the repository provides a solution for bypassing content restrictions in AI models, is implemented in Python, and is widely recognized within the developer community.

items.title: checkstyle/checkstyle
items.content:
Checkstyle is a development tool to help programmers write Java code that adheres to a coding standard. By default it supports the Google Java Style Guide and Sun Code Conventions, but is highly configurable. It can be invoked with an ANT task and a command line program.

Stars: 9542
Forks: 4218

summaries.zh: Checkstyle 是一款帮助程序员编写符合编码标准的 Java 代码的开发工具。它默认支持 Google Java 风格指南和 Sun 代码规范，并具有高度可配置性，可通过 ANT 任务及命令行程序调用。该项目以 Java 语言编写，在 GitHub 上拥有 9533 个 Star 和 4218 个 Fork。
summaries.en: Checkstyle is a development tool that helps Java programmers write code adhering to coding standards. It supports Google Java Style Guide and Sun Code Conventions by default, while being highly configurable. The tool can be run via an ANT task or the command line. Written in Java, it has 9,533 stars and 4,218 forks on GitHub.

summaries.zh: 该内容介绍的是一个名为“screenshot-to-code”的GitHub项目。它可以将用户上传的截图自动转换为整洁的代码，支持HTML、Tailwind、React和Vue等多种技术栈。项目主要使用Python编写，目前在GitHub上获得了76234颗星和9279次分叉，表明其受到广泛关注和使用。核心功能是简化前端开发流程，帮助开发者快速将设计稿转化为实际代码。
summaries.en: The article highlights "abi/screenshot-to-code," a popular open-source tool that converts screenshots into clean code. It supports multiple front-end technologies, including HTML, Tailwind CSS, React, and Vue. The project is written in Python and has gained significant traction, evidenced by its 76,234 stars and 9,279 forks. In essence, it is a widely adopted utility for developers seeking to speed up UI implementation by turning visual designs directly into usable code.
